BENILLA_KITCHEN_ART = "Interface\\Benilla\\journal\\" BENILLA_KITCHEN_SLOTS = 4 BENILLA_KITCHEN_LOG_LINES = 5 BENILLA_KITCHEN_NEWS = 4 BENILLA_KITCHEN_CUT_ROWS = 8 BENILLA_KITCHEN_ROW_HEIGHT = 50 BENILLA_KITCHEN_HEAD_HEIGHT = 20 BENILLA_KITCHEN_PANTRY_COLUMNS = 3 -- The realm cuts one fish into this many bait (`cooking.toml` [[cut]] count) and does not -- send the number. BENILLA_KITCHEN_CUT_COUNT = 3 BENILLA_KITCHEN_GREEN = { 0.118, 1.000, 0.000 } BENILLA_KITCHEN_GOLD = { 1.000, 0.820, 0.000 } BENILLA_KITCHEN_GREY = { 0.500, 0.500, 0.500 } BENILLA_KITCHEN_EDGE = { 0.431, 0.337, 0.161 } -- The prototype's lessons(): cook, recipe, eat, order, reveal, discover. BENILLA_KITCHEN_LESSONS = { { "Cook something", "In the Lion's Pride kitchen, choose Experiment and put Goldshire Perch, Dandelion Greens and Wild Onion in the pot. Every ingredient you cook with shows up in every unknown recipe that uses it. An exact match teaches the recipe. Anything else makes Hearty Mush."
-- mode is "recipe", "discover" or "experiment"; slots holds the pot's items, 0 for empty. BenillaKitchenState = { open = false, tab = "cook", mode = "experiment", key = "", n = 3, slots = { 0, 0, 0 }, book = {}, pantry = {}, log = {}, cut = 1, rows = 0, heads = 0, items = 0, groups = 0, }
function BenillaKitchen_ItemInfo(item) if not item or item == 0 then return nil end local name, _, quality, _, _, _, _, _, texture = GetItemInfo(item) return name, quality, texture end
function BenillaKitchen_Colour(quality) local colour = ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS and ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[quality or 1] if colour then return colour.r, colour.g, colour.b end return 1, 1, 1 end
-- An item's name wrapped in its quality colour code; "Unknown item" until the client knows it. function BenillaKitchen_Coloured(item) local name, quality = BenillaKitchen_ItemInfo(item) local r, g, b = BenillaKitchen_Colour(quality) return string.format("|cff%02x%02x%02x%s|r", math.floor(r * 255), math.floor(g * 255), math.floor(b * 255), name or "Unknown item") end
function BenillaKitchen_Name(item) return (BenillaKitchen_ItemInfo(item)) or "Unknown item" end
-- Copper as "1g 2s 84c", leaving out the empty coins. function BenillaKitchen_Money(copper) local g, s, c = math.floor(copper / 10000), math.mod(math.floor(copper / 100), 100), math.mod(copper, 100) local out = "" if g > 0 then out = out .. g .. "g " end if s > 0 then out = out .. s .. "s " end if c > 0 or out == "" then out = out .. c .. "c " end return string.sub(out, 1, -2) end
-- The "Use:" line of an item's tooltip, read off a hidden tooltip; "" when it has none. function BenillaKitchen_UseLine(item) if not item or item == 0 then return "" end if not BenillaKitchenScanTip then local ok = pcall(function() CreateFrame("GameTooltip", "BenillaKitchenScanTip", UIParent, "GameTooltipTemplate") end) if not ok or not BenillaKitchenScanTip then return "" end end local found = "" pcall(function() BenillaKitchenScanTip:SetOwner(UIParent, "ANCHOR_NONE") BenillaKitchenScanTip:SetHyperlink("item:" .. item .. ":0:0:0") for n = 1, BenillaKitchenScanTip:NumLines() do local line = getglobal("BenillaKitchenScanTipTextLeft" .. n) local text = line and line:GetText() if text and string.find(text, "^Use:") then found = text break end end BenillaKitchenScanTip:Hide() end) return found end
function BenillaKitchen_Text(parent, name, font) return parent:CreateFontString(name, "ARTWORK", getglobal(font) and font or nil) end
-- A 1 px line on each edge of `frame`, in r, g, b. function BenillaKitchen_Lines(frame, r, g, b) local points = { { "TOPLEFT", "TOPRIGHT", "height" }, { "BOTTOMLEFT", "BOTTOMRIGHT", "height" }, { "TOPLEFT", "BOTTOMLEFT", "width" }, { "TOPRIGHT", "BOTTOMRIGHT", "width" }, } local lines = {} for n, p in ipairs(points) do local line = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BORDER") line:SetTexture(r, g, b, 1) line:SetPoint(p[1], frame, p[1], 0, 0) line:SetPoint(p[2], frame, p[2], 0, 0) if p[3] == "height" then line:SetHeight(1) else line:SetWidth(1) end lines[n] = line end return lines end
-- The chip recipe of rows, slots and panels: a dark fill and a gold-dim border. function BenillaKitchen_ChipBack(frame) local bg = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") bg:SetTexture(0, 0, 0, 0.3) bg:SetAllPoints(frame) local e = BENILLA_KITCHEN_EDGE return BenillaKitchen_Lines(frame, e[1], e[2], e[3]) end
function BenillaKitchen_Build() for n = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_SLOTS do local slot = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaKitchenSlot" .. n, BenillaKitchenCookPage, "BenillaKitchenSlotTemplate") slot:SetID(n) slot:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaKitchenCookPage, "TOPLEFT", 276 + (n - 1) * 126, -102) slot.edge = BenillaKitchen_ChipBack(slot) end for n = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_LOG_LINES do local line = BenillaKitchen_Text(BenillaKitchenCookPage, "BenillaKitchenLog" .. n, "GameFontHighlightSmall") line:SetWidth(496) line:SetJustifyH("LEFT") line:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaKitchenCookPage, "TOPLEFT", 276, -448 - (n - 1) * 13) end for n = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_NEWS do local news = BenillaKitchen_Text(BenillaKitchenResult, "BenillaKitchenResultNews" .. n, "GameFontNormal") news:SetWidth(340) news:SetPoint("TOP", BenillaKitchenResult, "TOP", 0, -126 - (n - 1) * 18) local g = BENILLA_KITCHEN_GOLD news:SetTextColor(g[1], g[2], g[3]) end for n = 1, 3 do local order = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaKitchenOrder" .. n, BenillaKitchenOrdersPage, "BenillaKitchenOrderTemplate") order:SetID(n) order:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaKitchenOrdersPage, "TOPLEFT", 0, -30 - (n - 1) * 80) BenillaKitchen_ChipBack(order) end for n = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_CUT_ROWS do local row = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaKitchenCut" .. n, BenillaKitchenOrdersPage, "BenillaKitchenCutTemplate") row:SetID(n) row:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaKitchenOrdersPage, "TOPLEFT", 476, -60 - (n - 1) * 22) end BenillaKitchen_ChipBack(BenillaKitchenLesson) BenillaKitchen_ChipBack(BenillaKitchenPredict) BenillaKitchen_ChipBack(BenillaKitchenResult) BenillaKitchen_ChipBack(BenillaKitchenExperiment) local g = BENILLA_KITCHEN_GOLD BenillaKitchenLessonTitle:SetTextColor(g[1], g[2], g[3]) BenillaKitchenResultKick:SetTextColor(g[1], g[2], g[3]) if UISpecialFrames then tinsert(UISpecialFrames, "BenillaKitchen") end end
-- The open kitchen's book and pantry, read into Lua tables. function BenillaKitchen_Load() local _, _, numBook, numPantry = GetKitchen() local book, pantry = {}, {} for i = 1, numBook or 0 do local key, kind, effect, family, band, known, name, meal, numSlots = GetKitchenRecipe(i) local slots = {} for j = 1, numSlots do slots[j] = GetKitchenRecipeSlot(i, j) end book[i] = { key = key, kind = kind, effect = effect, family = family, band = band, known = known, name = name, meal = meal, slots = slots } end for i = 1, numPantry or 0 do local item, count, level, category, untried = GetKitchenIngredient(i) pantry[i] = { item = item, count = count, level = level, category = category, untried = untried } end BenillaKitchenState.book = book BenillaKitchenState.pantry = pantry end
function BenillaKitchen_Page(key) for _, page in ipairs(BenillaKitchenState.book) do if page.key == key then return page end end return nil end
function BenillaKitchen_Have(item) for _, p in ipairs(BenillaKitchenState.pantry) do if p.item == item then return p.count end end return 0 end
function BenillaKitchen_Used(item) local used = 0 for _, s in ipairs(BenillaKitchenState.slots) do if s == item then used = used + 1 end end return used end
-- The item slot `j` takes, or 0 for any. function BenillaKitchen_Accepts(j) local st = BenillaKitchenState if st.mode == "experiment" then return 0 end local page = BenillaKitchen_Page(st.key) return page and page.slots[j] or 0 end
function BenillaKitchen_Predict() local st = BenillaKitchenState st.waiting = true KitchenPredict(st.mode, st.key, unpack(st.slots)) end
-- Pick a mode and recipe and fill the pot: a recipe from its slots, an unknown recipe from -- its revealed slots, an experiment empty. function BenillaKitchen_Choose(mode, key) local st = BenillaKitchenState local page = BenillaKitchen_Page(key or "") if mode ~= "experiment" and not page then mode, key = "experiment", "" end st.mode, st.key = mode, key or "" st.slots = {} local n = page and mode ~= "experiment" and table.getn(page.slots) or st.n for j = 1, n do st.slots[j] = 0 end if mode ~= "experiment" then for j = 1, n do local item = page.slots[j] if item ~= 0 and BenillaKitchen_Have(item) - BenillaKitchen_Used(item) > 0 then st.slots[j] = item end end end BenillaKitchen_Predict() BenillaKitchen_PaintCook() end
-- The first empty slot that takes `item`, or nil. function BenillaKitchen_FreeSlot(item) local st = BenillaKitchenState if BenillaKitchen_Have(item) - BenillaKitchen_Used(item) <= 0 then return nil end for j, s in ipairs(st.slots) do local accepts = BenillaKitchen_Accepts(j) if s == 0 and (accepts == 0 or accepts == item) then return j end end return nil end
function BenillaKitchen_Add(item) local j = BenillaKitchen_FreeSlot(item) if j then BenillaKitchenState.slots[j] = item BenillaKitchen_Predict() BenillaKitchen_PaintCook() end end
function BenillaKitchen_SetSize(n) local st = BenillaKitchenState st.n = n local slots = {} for j = 1, n do slots[j] = st.slots[j] or 0 end st.slots = slots BenillaKitchen_Predict() BenillaKitchen_PaintCook() end
function BenillaKitchen_Empty() local st = BenillaKitchenState for j = 1, table.getn(st.slots) do st.slots[j] = 0 end BenillaKitchen_Predict() BenillaKitchen_PaintCook() end
function BenillaKitchenRefill_OnClick() local st = BenillaKitchenState if st.mode == "recipe" then BenillaKitchen_Choose(st.mode, st.key) else BenillaKitchen_Empty() end end
function BenillaKitchenCook_OnClick() local st = BenillaKitchenState st.waiting = true KitchenCook(st.mode, st.key, unpack(st.slots)) BenillaKitchen_PaintPrediction() end
function BenillaKitchen_Log(text) local log = BenillaKitchenState.log table.insert(log, text) while table.getn(log) > BENILLA_KITCHEN_LOG_LINES do table.remove(log, 1) end end
-- Grows the pool `prefix`1.. to `n` frames from `template` under `parent`. function BenillaKitchen_Pooled(kind, prefix, n, parent, template) local frame = getglobal(prefix .. n) if not frame then frame = CreateFrame(kind, prefix .. n, parent, template) if template == "BenillaKitchenRowTemplate" or template == "BenillaKitchenPantryTemplate" then BenillaKitchen_ChipBack(frame) end end frame:SetID(n) return frame end
-- The book: effect groups of tier recipes (once the book is open), the dishes, the legends, -- then Experiment. function BenillaKitchen_PaintBook() local st = BenillaKitchenState local child = BenillaKitchenBookChild local y, rows, heads = 0, 0, 0 local known, total = 0, 0 local open = GetKitchenLesson(1) local function head(left, right, gold) heads = heads + 1 local h = BenillaKitchen_Pooled("Frame", "BenillaKitchenHead", heads, child, "BenillaKitchenHeadTemplate") h:ClearAllPoints() h:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", child, "TOPLEFT", 0, -y) local text = getglobal(h:GetName() .. "Effect") text:SetText(left) local c = gold and BENILLA_KITCHEN_GOLD or BENILLA_KITCHEN_GREEN text:SetTextColor(c[1], c[2], c[3]) getglobal(h:GetName() .. "Family"):SetText(right or "") h:Show() y = y + BENILLA_KITCHEN_HEAD_HEIGHT end local function row(i, page, label) rows = rows + 1 local r = BenillaKitchen_Pooled("Button", "BenillaKitchenRow", rows, child, "BenillaKitchenRowTemplate") r:ClearAllPoints() r:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", child, "TOPLEFT", 0, -y) r.page = i local name = r:GetName() getglobal(name .. "Band"):SetText(label) local title = getglobal(name .. "Name") if page.known then local _, quality = BenillaKitchen_ItemInfo(page.meal) if page.kind == 2 or page.kind == 3 then quality = 5 end title:SetText(page.name) title:SetTextColor(BenillaKitchen_Colour(quality)) else title:SetText("???") local c = BENILLA_KITCHEN_GREY title:SetTextColor(c[1], c[2], c[3]) end for j = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_SLOTS do local chip = getglobal(name .. "Chip" .. j) local item = page.slots[j] if not item then chip:Hide() elseif item == 0 then chip:SetText("???") local c = BENILLA_KITCHEN_GREY chip:SetTextColor(c[1], c[2], c[3]) chip:Show() else chip:SetText(BenillaKitchen_Coloured(item)) chip:SetTextColor(1, 1, 1) chip:Show() end end if st.mode ~= "experiment" and st.key == page.key then getglobal(name .. "Selected"):Show() else getglobal(name .. "Selected"):Hide() end r:Show() y = y + BENILLA_KITCHEN_ROW_HEIGHT + 2 end local book = st.book for _, page in ipairs(book) do if page.kind == 0 then total = total + 1 if page.known then known = known + 1 end end end BenillaKitchenBookCount:SetText(known .. " of " .. total .. " known") if open then BenillaKitchenBookEmpty:Hide() local effect for i, page in ipairs(book) do if page.kind == 0 then if page.effect ~= effect then effect = page.effect head(page.effect, page.family) end row(i, page, "Band " .. page.band) end end else BenillaKitchenBookEmpty:SetText("Empty. Cook anything once and " .. (st.cook or "the cook") .. " shows you his recipes.") BenillaKitchenBookEmpty:Show() y = y + 40 end local sections = { { 1, "Fish dishes" }, { 2, "Legendary" } } for _, section in ipairs(sections) do local first = true for i, page in ipairs(book) do local kind = page.kind == 3 and 2 or page.kind if kind == section[1] then if first then head(section[2], nil, true) first = false end row(i, page, page.band > 0 and ("Band " .. page.band) or BENILLA_KITCHEN_KIND_LABELS[page.kind]) end end end head("Free", nil, true) BenillaKitchenExperiment:ClearAllPoints() BenillaKitchenExperiment:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", child, "TOPLEFT", 0, -y) if st.mode == "experiment" then BenillaKitchenExperimentSelected:Show() else BenillaKitchenExperimentSelected:Hide() end y = y + 40 for n = rows + 1, st.rows do getglobal("BenillaKitchenRow" .. n):Hide() end for n = heads + 1, st.heads do getglobal("BenillaKitchenHead" .. n):Hide() end st.rows = math.max(rows, st.rows) st.heads = math.max(heads, st.heads) child:SetHeight(math.max(y, 1)) BenillaKitchenBook:UpdateScrollChildRect() end
function BenillaKitchenRow_OnClick() local page = BenillaKitchenState.book[this.page] if page then BenillaKitchen_Choose(page.known and "recipe" or "discover", page.key) end end
function BenillaKitchen_PaintPot() local st = BenillaKitchenState local page = BenillaKitchen_Page(st.key) local title, sub = "Experiment", BENILLA_KITCHEN_EXPERIMENT_SUB BenillaKitchenPotTitle:SetTextColor(BENILLA_KITCHEN_GOLD[1], BENILLA_KITCHEN_GOLD[2], BENILLA_KITCHEN_GOLD[3]) if st.mode == "discover" and page then local hidden = 0 for _, s in ipairs(page.slots) do if s == 0 then hidden = hidden + 1 end end title = page.band > 0 and ("Unknown recipe · Band " .. page.band) or "Unknown recipe" sub = "Makes: " .. page.effect .. (page.band > 0 and (", band " .. page.band) or "") .. ". " if hidden > 0 then sub = sub .. hidden .. " of " .. table.getn(page.slots) .. " ingredients still hidden. Guess them, or cook with untried ingredients elsewhere to reveal them." else sub = sub .. "Every ingredient is revealed. Cook it to learn the recipe." end elseif st.mode == "recipe" and page then title = page.name local _, quality = BenillaKitchen_ItemInfo(page.meal) if page.kind == 2 or page.kind == 3 then quality = 5 end BenillaKitchenPotTitle:SetTextColor(BenillaKitchen_Colour(quality)) sub = "Makes: " .. page.effect .. " · " .. page.family .. (page.band > 0 and (" · Band " .. page.band) or "") .. "." end BenillaKitchenPotTitle:SetText(title) BenillaKitchenPotSub:SetText(sub) for n = 2, 4 do local b = getglobal("BenillaKitchenSize" .. n) if st.mode == "experiment" then b:Show() if st.n == n then b:LockHighlight() else b:UnlockHighlight() end else b:Hide() end end if st.mode == "experiment" then BenillaKitchenSizeLabel:Show() else BenillaKitchenSizeLabel:Hide() end for j = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_SLOTS do local slot = getglobal("BenillaKitchenSlot" .. j) local item = st.slots[j] if not item then slot:Hide() else local name = slot:GetName() local accepts = BenillaKitchen_Accepts(j) local guess = st.mode == "discover" and accepts == 0 local e = guess and BENILLA_KITCHEN_GOLD or BENILLA_KITCHEN_EDGE for _, line in ipairs(slot.edge) do line:SetTexture(e[1], e[2], e[3], 1) end getglobal(name .. "Label"):SetText(accepts ~= 0 and BenillaKitchen_Name(accepts) or "Any") local icon = getglobal(name .. "Icon") local text = getglobal(name .. "Name") local empty = getglobal(name .. "Empty") if item ~= 0 then local _, _, texture = BenillaKitchen_ItemInfo(item) icon:SetTexture(texture) icon:Show() text:SetText(BenillaKitchen_Coloured(item)) text:Show() empty:Hide() else icon:Hide() text:Hide() if accepts == 0 then empty:SetText("Empty. Pick from the pantry.") else empty:SetText("You have no " .. BenillaKitchen_Name(accepts) .. ".") end empty:Show() end slot.item = item slot:Show() end end if st.mode == "recipe" then BenillaKitchenRefill:SetText("Refill") else BenillaKitchenRefill:SetText("Empty the pot") end end
function BenillaKitchenSlot_OnClick() local st = BenillaKitchenState local j = this:GetID() if st.slots[j] and st.slots[j] ~= 0 then st.slots[j] = 0 BenillaKitchen_Predict() BenillaKitchen_PaintCook() end end
function BenillaKitchen_ItemTip(item) if item and item ~= 0 then GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:" .. item .. ":0:0:0") GameTooltip:Show() end end
function BenillaKitchen_PaintPrediction() local st = BenillaKitchenState local ready, meal, note, numWhy = GetKitchenPrediction() local waiting = st.waiting or ready == nil local why = "" if waiting then BenillaKitchenPredictMeal:SetText("") BenillaKitchenPredictUse:SetText("") elseif ready and meal ~= 0 then BenillaKitchenPredictMeal:SetText(BenillaKitchen_Coloured(meal)) BenillaKitchenPredictUse:SetText(BenillaKitchen_UseLine(meal)) elseif ready then BenillaKitchenPredictMeal:SetText("A guess") BenillaKitchenPredictUse:SetText("") else BenillaKitchenPredictMeal:SetText("") BenillaKitchenPredictUse:SetText(note) end if not waiting then for i = 1, numWhy do why = why .. (i > 1 and "\n" or "") .. "- " .. GetKitchenPredictionWhy(i) end end BenillaKitchenPredictWhy:SetText(why) if ready and not waiting then BenillaKitchenCook:Enable() else BenillaKitchenCook:Disable() end end
-- The pantry's groups: Fish, each herb category in pantry order, then the legends. function BenillaKitchen_PaintPantry() local st = BenillaKitchenState local child = BenillaKitchenPantryChild local order, groups = {}, {} local function group(category) if not groups[category] then groups[category] = {} table.insert(order, category) end return groups[category] end group("fish") for _, p in ipairs(st.pantry) do if p.category ~= "legend" and p.category ~= "plant" then table.insert(group(p.category), p) end end for _, p in ipairs(st.pantry) do if p.category == "legend" or p.category == "plant" then table.insert(group("legendary"), p) end end local y, items, labels = 0, 0, 0 for _, category in ipairs(order) do local list = groups[category] if table.getn(list) > 0 then labels = labels + 1 local label = getglobal("BenillaKitchenPantryGroup" .. labels) if not label then label = BenillaKitchen_Text(child, "BenillaKitchenPantryGroup" .. labels, "GameFontNormalSmall") label:SetJustifyH("LEFT") end label:ClearAllPoints() label:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", child, "TOPLEFT", 0, -y) if category == "fish" then label:SetText("Fish") elseif category == "legendary" then label:SetText("Legendary plants") else label:SetText(string.upper(string.sub(category, 1, 1)) .. string.sub(category, 2)) end label:Show() y = y + 14 for n, p in ipairs(list) do items = items + 1 local b = BenillaKitchen_Pooled("Button", "BenillaKitchenPantryItem", items, child, "BenillaKitchenPantryTemplate") local col = math.mod(n - 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_PANTRY_COLUMNS) b:ClearAllPoints() b:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", child, "TOPLEFT", col * 164, -y) if col == BENILLA_KITCHEN_PANTRY_COLUMNS - 1 or n == table.getn(list) then y = y + 36 end b.item = p.item local name = b:GetName() local _, _, texture = BenillaKitchen_ItemInfo(p.item) getglobal(name .. "Icon"):SetTexture(texture) getglobal(name .. "Name"):SetText(BenillaKitchen_Coloured(p.item)) getglobal(name .. "Meta"):SetText("L" .. p.level .. " · " .. (p.count - BenillaKitchen_Used(p.item)) .. " left") if p.untried then getglobal(name .. "New"):Show() else getglobal(name .. "New"):Hide() end if BenillaKitchen_FreeSlot(p.item) then b:Enable() b:SetAlpha(1) else b:Disable() b:SetAlpha(0.5) end b:Show() end y = y + 4 end end for n = items + 1, st.items do getglobal("BenillaKitchenPantryItem" .. n):Hide() end for n = labels + 1, st.groups do getglobal("BenillaKitchenPantryGroup" .. n):Hide() end st.items = math.max(items, st.items) st.groups = math.max(labels, st.groups) if items == 0 then BenillaKitchenPantryEmpty:Show() else BenillaKitchenPantryEmpty:Hide() end child:SetHeight(math.max(y, 1)) BenillaKitchenPantryScroll:UpdateScrollChildRect() end
function BenillaKitchenPantryItem_OnClick() BenillaKitchen_Add(this.item) end
function BenillaKitchen_PaintLessons() local now, done = nil, 0 for i = 1, 6 do if GetKitchenLesson(i) then done = done + 1 elseif not now then now = i end end if not now then BenillaKitchenLesson:Hide() return end BenillaKitchenLessonTitle:SetText(BENILLA_KITCHEN_LESSONS[now][1]) BenillaKitchenLessonText:SetText(BENILLA_KITCHEN_LESSONS[now][2]) BenillaKitchenLessonCount:SetText((BenillaKitchenState.cook or "") .. "'s lessons · " .. done .. " of 6") BenillaKitchenLesson:Show() end
function BenillaKitchen_PaintLog() local log = BenillaKitchenState.log for n = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_LOG_LINES do getglobal("BenillaKitchenLog" .. n):SetText(log[n] or "") end end
function BenillaKitchen_PaintCook() BenillaKitchen_PaintBook() BenillaKitchen_PaintPot() BenillaKitchen_PaintPrediction() BenillaKitchen_PaintPantry() end
function BenillaKitchen_PaintOrders() local st = BenillaKitchenState local _, cook, _, _, numOrders, numCuttable = GetKitchen() BenillaKitchenOrdersTitle:SetText("Orders from " .. (cook or "")) local ready = 0 for n = 1, 3 do local frame = getglobal("BenillaKitchenOrder" .. n) local label, kind, copper, qty, have, done, canDeliver, bonus, bonusRare = GetKitchenOrder(n) if label and n <= numOrders then local name = frame:GetName() getglobal(name .. "Kind"):SetText(BENILLA_KITCHEN_ORDER_KINDS[kind] or "") getglobal(name .. "Label"):SetText(label) local pays = "Pays " .. BenillaKitchen_Money(copper) if bonus ~= "" then local colour = bonusRare and "|cff0070dd" or "|cffffd100" pays = pays .. " and " .. colour .. bonus .. "|r" end getglobal(name .. "Pays"):SetText(pays) local deliver = getglobal(name .. "Deliver") if done then getglobal(name .. "Progress"):SetText("Delivered") deliver:Hide() frame:SetAlpha(0.6) else getglobal(name .. "Progress"):SetText("You have " .. have .. " / " .. qty) if canDeliver then deliver:Enable() ready = ready + 1 else deliver:Disable() end deliver:Show() frame:SetAlpha(1) end frame:Show() else frame:Hide() end end if ready > 0 then BenillaKitchenTab2:SetText("Orders & bait (" .. ready .. ")") else BenillaKitchenTab2:SetText("Orders & bait") end if st.cut > numCuttable then st.cut = 1 end for n = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_CUT_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaKitchenCut" .. n) local fish, count, bait = GetKitchenCuttable(n) if fish and n <= numCuttable then getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(BenillaKitchen_Coloured(fish) .. " (" .. count .. ") → " .. BENILLA_KITCHEN_CUT_COUNT .. " " .. BenillaKitchen_Coloured(bait)) if st.cut == n then row:LockHighlight() else row:UnlockHighlight() end row:Show() else row:Hide() end end if numCuttable > 0 then BenillaKitchenCutHint:SetText("Cut 1 fish into " .. BENILLA_KITCHEN_CUT_COUNT .. " bait. Each bait is the favourite of a bigger fish.") BenillaKitchenCutButton:Show() else BenillaKitchenCutHint:SetText("No common or uncommon fish to cut.") BenillaKitchenCutButton:Hide() end end
function BenillaKitchenOrderDeliver_OnClick() KitchenDeliver(this:GetParent():GetID()) end
function BenillaKitchenCutRow_OnClick() BenillaKitchenState.cut = this:GetID() BenillaKitchen_PaintOrders() end
function BenillaKitchenCutButton_OnClick() local fish = GetKitchenCuttable(BenillaKitchenState.cut) if fish then KitchenCut(fish) end end
function BenillaKitchen_ShowTab(tab) BenillaKitchenState.tab = tab if tab == "orders" then BenillaKitchenCookPage:Hide() BenillaKitchenOrdersPage:Show() else BenillaKitchenOrdersPage:Hide() BenillaKitchenCookPage:Show() end local tabs = { "cook", "orders" } for n, t in ipairs(tabs) do local bg = getglobal("BenillaKitchenTab" .. n .. "Bg") bg:SetTexture(BENILLA_KITCHEN_ART .. (t == tab and "bottom_tab_selected" or "bottom_tab")) end end
function BenillaKitchen_Update() local name, cook = GetKitchen() if not name then return end local st = BenillaKitchenState st.cook = cook BenillaKitchen_Load() BenillaKitchenTitle:SetText(name) BenillaKitchenCookName:SetText("cook: " .. cook) if not st.open then st.open = true st.log = {} st.n = 3 st.cut = 1 BenillaKitchenResult:Hide() BenillaKitchen_ShowTab("cook") BenillaKitchen:Show() BenillaKitchen_Choose("experiment", "") else -- The pantry changed under the pot: take out what the player no longer holds. for j, item in ipairs(st.slots) do if item ~= 0 and BenillaKitchen_Used(item) > BenillaKitchen_Have(item) then st.slots[j] = 0 end end BenillaKitchen_PaintCook() end BenillaKitchen_PaintLessons() BenillaKitchen_PaintLog() BenillaKitchen_PaintOrders() end
function BenillaKitchen_Prediction() BenillaKitchenState.waiting = false BenillaKitchen_PaintPrediction() end
-- A cooked pot: the result panel and the log, then the pot refilled for another go. function BenillaKitchen_Cooked() local meal, mush, close, line, numLearned, numRevealed = GetKitchenCooked() if not meal then return end local st = BenillaKitchenState BenillaKitchen_Load() local news, starters, discovered = {}, 0, nil for i = 1, numLearned do local key, name, learnedMeal = GetKitchenCookedLearned(i) if not mush and learnedMeal == meal and not discovered then discovered = key table.insert(news, "New recipe: " .. name .. "!") else starters = starters + 1 end end if starters > 0 then table.insert(news, 1, (st.cook or "The cook") .. " taught you " .. starters .. (starters == 1 and " recipe" or " recipes") .. ". Your recipe book is open.") end for i = 1, numRevealed do local item, count = GetKitchenCookedRevealed(i) if count > 0 then table.insert(news, BenillaKitchen_Name(item) .. " revealed in " .. count .. (count == 1 and " unknown recipe" or " unknown recipes")) end end BenillaKitchenResultKick:SetText(mush and "No recipe matched" or "You cooked") BenillaKitchenResultMeal:SetText(BenillaKitchen_Coloured(meal)) BenillaKitchenResultUse:SetText(BenillaKitchen_UseLine(meal)) BenillaKitchenResultLine:SetText(line) for n = 1, BENILLA_KITCHEN_NEWS do getglobal("BenillaKitchenResultNews" .. n):SetText(news[n] or "") end BenillaKitchenResult.meal = meal if UnitAffectingCombat and UnitAffectingCombat("player") then BenillaKitchenResultEat:Disable() else BenillaKitchenResultEat:Enable() end BenillaKitchenResult:Show() if line ~= "" then BenillaKitchen_Log(line) end BenillaKitchen_Log("You cooked " .. BenillaKitchen_Coloured(meal) .. ".") for _, n in ipairs(news) do BenillaKitchen_Log(n) end BenillaKitchen_PaintLog() st.waiting = false if discovered then BenillaKitchen_Choose("recipe", discovered) else BenillaKitchen_Choose(st.mode, st.key) end end
-- Eat it now: uses the cooked meal from the bags. function BenillaKitchenResultEat_OnClick() local meal = BenillaKitchenResult.meal BenillaKitchenResult:Hide() if not meal or not GetContainerNumSlots then return end for bag = 0, 4 do for slot = 1, GetContainerNumSlots(bag) or 0 do local link = GetContainerItemLink(bag, slot) local _, _, id = string.find(link or "", "item:(%d+)") if id and tonumber(id) == meal then UseContainerItem(bag, slot) return end end end end
function BenillaKitchen_Closed() BenillaKitchenState.open = false BenillaKitchenResult:Hide() BenillaKitchen:Hide() end
-- The window hidden by Escape or the close button: the realm closes the kitchen. function BenillaKitchen_OnHide() if BenillaKitchenState.open then BenillaKitchenState.open = false KitchenClose() end end
function BenillaKitchen_Wheel(scroll, delta) local v = scroll:GetVerticalScroll() - delta * 40 local range = scroll:GetVerticalScrollRange() if v > range then v = range end if v < 0 then v = 0 end scroll:SetVerticalScroll(v) end
